text:
alice: Heads-up — during a long-context perf run (12k tokens) I saw steady KV memory growth and a few hot shards that never evict. Can we add more residency/fragmentation metrics + a heatmap dashboard to find reuse patterns?

ben: Do you have a small repro trace or profiler output? I can start by adding PromQL panels for hit rate and residency. :+1:

alice: Pasted a short sampler below (from local profiler):
```
KV shard=3 residency_bytes=1.9GB live_entries=8200 evicted_entries=120 eviction_cycles=3
KV shard=7 residency_bytes=2.1GB live_entries=9200 evicted_entries=0 eviction_cycles=0
trace: repeated PG_row lookups from same prefix -> looks like reuse but not being compacted
```

caroline: Interesting — shard 7 looks like a leak (evicted_entries=0). We should track two addtl counters: total_fragmentation_bytes and last_compaction_ts per shard. Also a per-request label on evictions (route/model) so we can correlate traffic patterns.

ben: Agreed. Proposed immediate PromQLs for dashboard panels: 
- KV hit rate (global): `sum(kv_hits_total) / sum(kv_lookups_total)`
- Residency per shard (bytes): `kv_residency_bytes{job="runtime"}`
- Eviction rate: `rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])`
- Fragmentation estimate: `kv_allocated_bytes - kv_residency_bytes`

Also a heatmap of residency percentiles over time: `histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(kv_residency_bucket[5m])) by (le, shard))` — gives per-shard residency distribution.

david: For alerts: propose `rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]) > 5` AND `kv_residency_bytes / kv_allocated_bytes > 0.9` for 10m -> P2. We should avoid noisy alerts; maybe only fire if shard count > 3 and affecting > 10% of requests.

alice: I'll upload a short trace file to the eng-runtime drive. Also note that the issue only appears for models with long KV lifetimes (chat with long context/history + many system messages). Could be fragmentation from repeated small writes.

caroline: For instrumentation changes: add labels: shard, model, route, cause (write/evict/compact). Increment `kv_compactions_total{shard}` on compaction runs. Emit `kv_fragmentation_bytes{shard}` periodically.

ben: UI idea — add a per-model heatmap that shows "residency percentile vs time since write" so we can see reuse vs cold writes. Panel mock (short):
```
- X axis: time since write (buckets: 0-1s, 1-10s, 10-100s, 100-1k, 1k+)
- Y axis: residency percentile (p50,p90,p99)
- Color: request count hitting that bucket
```

perf-bot: Weekly KV summary: avg_hit_rate=0.93, avg_eviction_rate=0.12/min, high_residency_shards=[7,11], fragmentation_p50=120MB

david: Can someone add the queries + a draft grafana dashboard? I can wire up alerting afterwards.

alice: @ben @caroline thanks — if you can prioritize a minimal dashboard with (hit rate, residency per-shard, evictions, fragmentation estimate) that'd be huge. I'll attach the trace and sample workload next.

ben: Will do. I'll drop a PR that adds the new metrics and a dashboard JSON. ETA EOD tomorrow.

caroline: I'll add the compaction instrumentation and a short doc snippet describing how to interpret fragmentation vs residency.

alice: Great — adding a short acceptance checklist: 
- [ ] Residency per-shard panel
- [ ] Global and per-model hit rate
- [ ] Eviction rate with label breakdown
- [ ] Fragmentation bytes panel
- [ ] Heatmap of "time-since-write" vs reuse

ben: Copy. Starting work now.

(implicit) end of thread
